assessments.nearest_work_difference: For valid event i define v_i = w_c,i*c_i + w_b,i*b_i + 0.5*(w_c,i+w_b,i)*common_i, with exactly the parent event weights. Form r_g = sum_{i in g} v_i via [B,4,L] bmm [B,L,d]; sum_g r_g reconstructs the parent raw readout. Let N(z,p)=z*||p||/||z|| for ||z||>1e-6, otherwise p, and lift(p)=concat(p,p,p,p)/2. Resolved layout is N(concat(r_0,r_1,r_2,r_3),lift(pooled)); collapsed layout is lift(N(sum_i v_i,pooled)). Both are 4*d vectors with norm ||pooled||, including finite fallbacks. No individual group normalization is introduced. All four cells compute both layouts and differ only in group_slots and target_query. Original 420 features are unchanged; appended width increases from 16 to 64, total width 484. Expected total parameters 17,153,315 (17,078,688 embedding; 74,627 dense), +6,144 over balanced_target. All four have identical Model AST and allocated parameter shapes/order. Collapsed slots repeat the parent readout isometrically and supply no additional readout information: setting each block of classifier weights to half the parent weights embeds the parent function exactly. This matches allocated capacity, not effective feature rank or optimizer conditioning. The resolved direction and induced optimization geometry change together. The contrast tests the utility of this group-resolved representation, not a uniquely identified causal explanation or a novelty claim.
